protocol.machine: Apple M4 Pro, 10 performance + 4 efficiency cores, 48 GiB
protocol.integration: 1D full pixel split, 2000 uniform 2theta degree bins, solid angle, polarization 0.965
protocol.matrix: Same Dioptrin lookup table and float64 normalization in both engines; upstream requires float32 weights
protocol.orientation: Original PONI orientation 2: flip HDF5 frames for Dioptrin; remap CSC columns for raw chunks. Stored TIFF mask already bottom-up.
protocol.cache: Warm macOS filesystem cache; no cache flush; no output-file writing timed
protocol.threading: 1/4/8 workers; no nested BLAS/OpenMP; Dioptrin global Rayon W for arrays, W one-thread file-stream workers; bslz4 W contexts sharing plan, 2 frames per native call
protocol.repeats: Three warmed measurements, alternate forward/reverse workflow order; >=1 second per block
protocol.file_scope: 32 distinct frames spread across all 625 for worker scaling; all 625 at eight workers
protocol.baseline: Current batch1d_iter HDF5 generator API; separate parallel bslz4 decompression + Dioptrin control uses bounded 32-frame stage batches
protocol.statistics: Poisson variant uses stacked squared-weight rows in unmodified upstream; no errors requested from stock upstream API
protocol.background: Other processes left running; competing CPU use recorded per block; no CPU pinning
protocol.limitations: CPU only; no cold disk or network I/O, output writing, detector acquisition, 2D integration, supersampling, or azimuthal std timed
protocol.builds: Dioptrin source release wheel: opt-level=3, LTO=true, codegen-units=1, generic CPU target. Upstream default Apple clang -O2 with runtime ARM kernels; no extra flags.
protocol.reusable_control: Additional paired eight-worker runs: per-thread uint32 decode buffers, W reusable float64 buffers, direct compressed-buffer pointers, synchronous borrowed-array Dioptrin batches. Preloaded sample image arrays released before these timings.
protocol.tuning: Batches 1/2/4/8 plus explicit CSC, CSC-run, NEON untranspose and stock LZ4 tested on 32 distributed frames repeated four times. CSC winner verified in five full-625-frame paired runs; compute-only CSC compared in three more runs.
